settings.eyebrow: EST. 1974 · A SINGAPORE BRAND · BUILT FOR PROFESSIONALS, NOW EVERYONE
settings.heading: Every foot is different. We've known since 1974.
settings.text: From a boy learning the trade in his father's shoe factory to more than a million pairs made and fitted — this is how Foot Tree got here.

settings.paragraph_1: Hi, I'm Shi Ying, and I look after Foot Tree today. [One line on how you came to Foot Tree — e.g. your link to the founder.]
settings.paragraph_2: Our story starts well before me — with a boy in his father's shoe factory, and the lesson he learned there.

settings.heading: Where it all began
settings.body:
Our founder grew up in his father's shoe factory in Singapore, learning the trade at the bench from a young age.

It taught him the idea every Foot Tree shoe is still built on: comfort is not one size fits all.
settings.brief: PHOTO — archive. The family shoe factory, or our founder as a young man at the bench. Ask the family for originals.
settings.caption: [Caption — who, where and roughly when]

settings.heading: Foot Tree is born
settings.body:
He opened Foot Tree in 1974 with a simple promise: make the shoe fit the foot, not the other way round.

[Where the first shop or workshop was, and what it made first — confirm.]
settings.brief: PHOTO — archive. The first shop front, 1970s.
settings.brief_2: PHOTO — archive. One of the first pairs, or an early price tag.
settings.caption: [Caption — the first shop, 197X]

settings.heading: Shoes for Singapore's working day
settings.body:
Nurses, cabin crew and bus captains spend all day on their feet. We began making uniform footwear for the teams who keep the country running.

Today, more than 80 organisations outfit their teams with us.
settings.brief: PHOTO — an on-site fitting: a Foot Tree fitter measuring a staff member in uniform. Real people, 45–70. No client logos.
settings.caption: [Caption — an early corporate fitting, 19XX]

settings.heading: Our own factory
settings.body:
As more people came to us, we built our own factory. Every style is still designed in Singapore and hand made in-house.

That means we own the lasts — the forms every shoe is shaped on. It's why we can make the widths and sizes other brands skip.
settings.brief: PHOTO — hands lasting an upper at the bench. Close, warm, real workers.
settings.caption: [Caption — inside our factory]

settings.heading: A home at City Square
settings.body: We opened our store at City Square Mall so anyone could walk in and be fitted properly — both feet measured, not guessed.
settings.brief: PHOTO — the shopfront from the mall walkway, lights on, a fitter at the door.
settings.caption: [Caption — our City Square store, opened 20XX]

settings.heading: Designed in Singapore. Hand made in-house. Fitted in person.
settings.paragraph_1: Every material comes from suppliers we trust, and every pair is checked at each stage of making — not just at the end.
settings.paragraph_2: Our work shoes are slip-resistant and supportive for long shifts. Across the range you'll find wide fits, half sizes and extended sizes, with styles that make room for bunions.
settings.paragraph_3: That's why we still own every step, from the first sketch to the fitting.
settings.brief: PHOTO — a fitting at City Square today: a Foot Tree fitter checking a customer's foot width. Customer 50+, natural light, real staff.
settings.caption: [Caption — a fitting at our City Square store]

settings.title: Fit for more feet
settings.text: Wide fits, half sizes and extended sizes, plus styles with room for bunions. Owning our lasts is what makes that possible.

settings.title: Built for the whole shift
settings.text: Slip-resistant soles and firm support in our work range, for people who stand and walk all day.

settings.title: Checked at every stage
settings.text: Materials from suppliers we trust, and quality checks at every step of making — not just at the end.

settings.title: Wrong size? Swap it free
settings.text: Bought the wrong size? Exchange it free at our City Square store within 30 days.

settings.heading: Made for long days on your feet
settings.lead: What goes into every pair — whether you buy one for yourself or outfit a whole team.

settings.title: Healthcare
settings.text: Supportive shoes for long shifts on hard hospital floors.

settings.title: Aviation
settings.text: Smart, comfortable shoes that stay polished from check-in to landing.

settings.title: Transport
settings.text: Steady support for drivers and crews who are on the move all day.

settings.title: F&B
settings.text: Slip-resistant shoes for busy kitchens and service floors.

settings.heading: Made for the people who keep Singapore running
settings.lead: Healthcare, aviation, transport and F&B teams count on us to keep their people comfortable through the whole shift.

settings.heading: Outfitting a team?
settings.text: We keep stock on hand so lead times stay short, make bulk orders in our own factory, deliver across Singapore and fit your team on site.

settings.paragraph_1: For over fifty years, we've made shoes for the people who keep Singapore running. Now we'd love to fit you too.
settings.paragraph_2: Whether you stand through a twelve-hour shift or simply need a shoe with more room, come and see us.
